# Email and SMS/RCS Notifications

OrderHub can automatically notify your customers by **email** and/or **SMS/RCS** when an order is **shipped** or **completed**. Both channels are configured in the **Notify** tab of your Organization settings.

---

## How It Works

When notifications are enabled in OrderHub, it takes ownership of customer communication for the configured triggers. If your orders originate from Pixfizz, OrderHub automatically suppresses duplicate Pixfizz notifications by passing `sendNotifications: false` back to the Pixfizz API.

### Notification Triggers

| Trigger | When It Fires |
|---|---|
| **Shipped** | After a shipping label is purchased (EasyPost), or when an order is manually moved to "shipped" status |
| **Completed** | When an order is manually moved to "completed" status |

Each trigger can be independently enabled or disabled using the **Send on Shipped** and **Send on Completed** toggles.

---

## Email Notifications

Emails are sent via your existing **n8n / SendGrid** pipeline.

### Prerequisites

1. An **n8n webhook URL** configured in your Organization API secrets
2. At least one active Pixfizz website linked to your organization (for branding)

### How Branding Works

OrderHub automatically resolves branding (logo and colors) using this priority chain:

1. The Pixfizz website linked directly to the order
2. The Pixfizz website linked to the order's pickup location
3. Your organization's first active Pixfizz website (fallback)

### Email Settings

| Setting | Description |
|---|---|
| **From Name** | The sender name shown in the customer's inbox (e.g., "Your Photo Lab") |
| **Reply-To** | Where replies go (optional) |
| **BCC** | Get a copy of every notification sent (optional) |
| **Shipped Subject** | Email subject line for shipped notifications |
| **Shipped Body** | Email body for shipped notifications |
| **Completed Subject** | Email subject line for completed notifications |
| **Completed Body** | Email body for completed notifications |

### Placeholders

Use these placeholders in your email templates — they'll be replaced with real order data:

| Placeholder | Replaced With |
|---|---|
| `{{customer_name}}` | Customer's name from the order |
| `{{order_number}}` | The order number |
| `{{tracking_url}}` | Tracking link (shipping orders only) |
| `{{website_name}}` | Your website/brand name |
| `{{customer_email}}` | Customer's email address |

---

## SMS/RCS Notifications

SMS and RCS messages are sent directly to **Twilio's REST API**. Each organization uses its own Twilio credentials, so different organizations can have separate Twilio accounts.

### Prerequisites

1. A **Twilio account** with an active phone number
2. Your **Account SID**, **Auth Token**, and **From Number** entered in the Notify settings

> For a step-by-step guide on setting up your Twilio account, see the separate **Twilio Setup Guide**.

### SMS Settings

| Setting | Description |
|---|---|
| **Twilio Account SID** | Your Twilio account identifier |
| **Twilio Auth Token** | Your Twilio authentication token (stored securely) |
| **From Number** | The Twilio phone number messages are sent from (e.g., +61412345678) |
| **RCS Enabled** | Toggle to use RCS messaging (falls back to SMS automatically if the recipient doesn't support RCS) |
| **Shipped Body** | SMS message for shipped notifications |
| **Completed Body** | SMS message for completed notifications |

The same placeholders available for email templates also work in SMS templates.

### Two-Way SMS (Inbound Messages)

OrderHub supports **inbound SMS** via a Twilio webhook, enabling two-way conversations with customers.

#### Setting Up the Inbound Webhook

In your Twilio console, set the **Messaging Webhook URL** for your phone number to:

```
https://nazkcvruighrhpgcarxg.supabase.co/functions/v1/twilio-inbound-webhook
```

Once configured, customer replies appear in the **SMS Conversation** panel on the order detail page.

#### Automated Keyword Responses

OrderHub can automatically respond to certain keywords:

| Keyword | Behaviour |
|---|---|
| `STATUS [order#]` | Looks up the order and replies with the current status |
| `STOP` | Handled by Twilio (opt-out compliance) |
| Custom keywords | Managed via **Auto-Replies** in the Notify settings (e.g., HELP, HOURS) |

Auto-replies are configured in the **Auto-Replies** section of the Notify tab. Each auto-reply has a keyword trigger and a response message.

---

## Testing Notifications

Both the Email and SMS tabs include a **Send Test** button. This lets you:

- Enter any email address or phone number (no dependency on your own profile)
- Choose which template to test (shipped or completed)
- Send a sample notification with dummy order data

Test notifications use placeholder values like "Order #TEST-001" and "Test Customer" so you can verify formatting without affecting real orders.

---

## Notification Priority Rules

When OrderHub notifications are enabled, it coordinates with Pixfizz to prevent duplicate messages:

| Scenario | Who Sends? |
|---|---|
| OH email enabled + trigger enabled | **OrderHub** sends email, Pixfizz is suppressed |
| OH email disabled | **Pixfizz** sends its own notifications (if configured) |
| OH SMS enabled + customer has phone | **OrderHub** sends SMS (Pixfizz doesn't send SMS) |
| OH SMS enabled + no phone on order | No SMS sent |
| Manual status change with "Notify" unchecked | Neither OH nor Pixfizz sends |

---

## Notification Log

Every notification attempt is logged on the order in the `notification_log` field. This records:

- Channel (email or SMS)
- Trigger (shipped or completed)
- Timestamp
- Success or failure status
- Error details (if any)

---

## Troubleshooting

| Problem | Solution |
|---|---|
| Emails not sending | Check that the n8n webhook URL is configured in your Organization API secrets |
| SMS not sending | Verify your Twilio credentials (Account SID, Auth Token, From Number) in the Notify tab |
| Customer not receiving SMS | Ensure the order has a phone number with country code (e.g., +61...) |
| Duplicate notifications | This shouldn't happen — OrderHub suppresses Pixfizz notifications when enabled. If it does, check that the Pixfizz integration is properly linked |
| Branding not appearing in emails | Ensure at least one active Pixfizz website is linked to your organization |
| Inbound SMS not appearing | Verify the Twilio webhook URL is correctly configured in your Twilio console |
| Auto-replies not working | Check that the keyword is configured in the Auto-Replies section and is an exact match |
